0022600030.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-4, 2-3 on the road, 4th in the Atlantic and 3.5 games back) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, 0-4 at home... wait, they're 1-3 at home) as the Bucks look to end a four-game losing streak. The Raptors come in on a one-game losing streak, while the Bucks sit 5th in the Central, five games back, and 15th in the East. For Toronto, Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out, while Kyle Anderson (illness) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions; for Milwaukee, Kam Jones (ankle) is day-to-day, also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 122-94 win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
